title: City Council — March 3, 2026 Work Session, CDRA Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Highland
MOTION: Board Member Newell moved to ADJOURN the CDRA Meeting and move into a Closed Session to discuss the Purchase of Real Property. The motion was seconded by Board Member Hyland
MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland

MOTION: Council Member Newell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-16 Approving an Agreement with Perkins Engineering, Inc. for Engineering Services. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-17 Approving an Agreement with the State of Utah Concerning Use of the America250 Name, Logo and Identity. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton- Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Birrell-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes
MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to APPROVE the Minutes for the City Council Work Session and Business Meetings of February 17, 2026. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell
MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Birrell
